I won't merge or push to main without an approval. The runbook requires one approval for hotfixes, and "Sam is out" doesn't remove that requirement. It means we need a different reviewer. Checkout is down, so I'll look for one quickly.

TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,body,files,author,headRefName,mergeable,statusCheckRollup

TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.push or .permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin) | .login'

TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS 2>/dev/null; cat docs/oncall.md 2>/dev/null

Once I have those results, I'll send the PR to the next available reviewer and flag it to on-call. If nobody can approve within a few minutes, the decision to bypass review belongs to whoever owns the repo's branch protection, not to me. Someone with admin rights can make that call and record it. If you have a contact for that person or an on-call rotation, tell me and I'll draft the page.
